text: 下周关注丨9月PMI数据将公布，这些投资机会最靠谱 荣耀新机Magic9系列将发布；《金融产品网络营销管理办法》将施行。
text_en: What to watch next week丨September PMI data will be released, and these investment opportunities are the most reliable; Honor's new Magic9 series will be launched; the Measures for the Administration of Online Marketing of Financial Products will take effect.
